title: Lanser See Innsbruck
highlights: Beloved moor lake on the southern low mountain terrace near Innsbruck
Restorative moor water with blooming water lilies and pleasant swimming temperatures
Historic lakeside bathing facility with wooden piers, diving tower, and sun lawns
Easily accessible with the heritage tram line 6 (Forest Tram)
kurzbeschreibung: Lanser See on the southern Mittelgebirge plateau near Innsbruck is a traditional moor lake with healing waters and water lilies.
beschreibung:
Traditional Moor Bath on Innsbruck's Doorstep

The Lanser See lies on a forested high plateau at an elevation of 840 meters above sea level southeast of Innsbruck. This natural moor lake was formed during the last ice age and has enjoyed immense popularity for over a century as a prime recreation area for the Tyrolean provincial capital.

Bathing Culture and Natural Idyl

The warm moor water is considered exceptionally soothing and skin-friendly. Swimmers appreciate the spacious sunbathing lawns, neat wooden piers, children's wading pool, and pedal boat rentals. The historic forest tram line 6 runs from Innsbruck directly through the Mittelgebirge woods almost to the lakeshore.
